visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a handheld close-up of a paper bag containing golden-brown fried taro snacks. Captions appear at the bottom as a hand holds the bag. (2) A close-up shows a fried snack being pulled apart, revealing a stretchy, gooey white cheese filling mixed with purple taro mash. (3) A medium shot features an elderly woman with short curly hair, wearing a purple long-sleeved shirt and a brown apron with a cat logo, gesturing and talking towards the camera. (4) A close-up of a menu card follows, listing various taro and sweet potato snack options with prices. (5) A montage shows the woman wearing a purple mask and gloves at a food stall, preparing the snacks by scooping purple taro mash from a large metal bowl into small balls. (6) Close-up of hands placing cubes of cheese into the center of taro mash and rolling them into balls. (7) The taro balls are shown being dipped into a bowl of yellow egg wash and then coated in light-colored breadcrumbs. (8) A metal strainer lifts several rectangular fried taro biscuits out of a deep fryer filled with bubbling oil. (9) A series of close-ups showcase different snacks being broken open: one with melted cheese, one with a bright orange salted egg yolk, and one with dark red bean paste. (10) Two hands break open a rectangular cracker-style snack filled with purple taro mash, displaying the flaky texture. (11) The final shot shows the snacks in the bag with a yellow sign in the background and a location text overlay at the bottom.

A subtle sound of crispy food breaking is audible. (2) The owner's voice briefly interrupts, describing the process with a warm, friendly tone. The music continues at a steady 124 BPM. (3) A sizzling sound effect of frying oil enters the mix as the narrator returns, listing various flavors. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (4) Distinct crunching SFX are used to emphasize the crispiness of the snacks being shown visually. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging. (5) The narrator concludes with a CTA, the music swells slightly before a clean hard cut at the end.
